text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ seizes a stunning victory
at the
Takarazuka Kinen! She's reached
the top of the
ranks!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We discuss our upcoming race schedule.
Narita
Brian will most likely aim for the
Arima Kinen
after winning the Classic
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So we decide to shoot for the autumn
Tenno Sho
and work on improving Biwa
Hayahide's raw
speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home, I can't help but notice
how
tired Бива Хаяхидэ is. I try to think
of what I can
do to help.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
